brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a 3d minecraft clone but every ore block is a post from you or someone in your moot circle and the number of likes the post has is how much ore it gives you when you mine it
note: built mootcraft: a first-person voxel mine where ore blocks buried in the dirt are real posts from you + your moots, and each one pays out ore exactly equal to its like count. dig in.
